counterexamples.finding: Theorem2.1requires compact domain, continuous objective with unique separated interior maximum and sufficiently large parameter depending on delta/sigma/domain;PGSnonnegative. Cor3.9bounds min expected squared gradient of transformed surrogate, not directly distance to original optimum. Approximate stationarity can occur far away as Gaussian convolution gradient vanishes at infinity; global distance/last-iterate convergence needs additional argument. TheoryEq5 unnormalized vs Algorithm1normalized/samplebaseline practical updates differ. Record these as unresolved bridge questions rather than certify global polynomial optimization.

Fixed gamma>0 gives exponent2/(1−2gamma), only approaches2 asgamma→0 with constants depending ongamma; cannot silently replace by exactO(eps^-2). Ass4.1can shrinkFandgradient magnitude asNincreases; removingNfromabsolute stationarity bound does not remove delta/sample/global-search dependence. C9extends f=0 outsideS but exp(f)=1outside conflicts fNcutoff0 and may introduce boundary derivative terms; zero boundaryf alone not smooth zeroextension. Generalpositive-realN conflicts PGS polynomialidentity/negative derivative-coefficient regimes. No independent proof certification.

CMA-ESstrongestAckley/Rosenbrock/MNIST, EPGS98%R²vsZOSLGHd99%onCIFAR despite summary sayingequal. EPGS R²98%with98%success vsZO-SGD99%conditionalon62%success is different tradeoff. Iteration-to-best not equalquery/wallclock;CMApopulationcostdiffers. Hyperparametersselectedon100trials or10attackimages, noheldoutoverlapdetail. TargetCNNs/datasets2only, notgeneral modernrobustness/securityclaim.

Fig4sigma1.0vappendix0.5, RosenbrockN3vselectedN1, CNNtestaccuracies97.4/86.2vs97.8/86.0. Two-logclaimedexactpeakat−0.5shiftedslightlybysecondlog; fRosenbrock+20000notgloballypositiveonunboundedGaussiansearch. STD-HomotopytextGaussianvAlgorithm2uniformsphere; samplingcovarianceσvsσ² inconsistent. Reconcile in author notes, do not quietly mutate numbers/formulas or copy mistakes as style.
